summary: Fully revised Implementation Plan (v24) resolving all 7 audit findings: adds RLS policies and SECURITY DEFINER search_path to Phase 1 migrations; unifies differential cancel keying on canonical_id in Phase 2; implements ISO date parsing with safe NULL fallbacks for valid_from/valid_to in Phase 2 & SQL RPC; removes stale navarea_sync_logs writes in Phase 4; re-points frontend fetchLiveNavWarnings to nav_warnings_active_spatial with geojson_blob mapping in Phase 5; preserves migration immutability via forward migration 20261020_realtime_and_audit.sql; and adds integration tests for active_spatial view joins and non-zero exit codes on missing credentials in Phase 6.
